'''Twilight Of The Republic''' is the second of two releases of [[Virtual Block 9]], a legacy virtual expansion. Its text is official as of 14 July 2014.<ref name="pdf" /> The release has 11 cards: 5 Dark Side and 6 Light Side.<ref name="pdf" />

== Discrepancies ==
* The alternate-image version [[Dexter Jettster (AI)]] on the [[Virtual Block 9]] card list is not in this release PDF.<ref name="pdf" />
